title: This website
subtitle: the making-of
summary: How this site went from an empty folder to live: the references, the storyboards, the palettes and the build.

body.heading: The brief
body.text: Show the work, grow the audience a little, and don't look like every other portfolio. Not taking clients, so no hire-me buttons.

body.heading: The references
body.text: Ralph Lauren for structure (navy, crests, stripes). Vox for the voice (cut-outs, highlighter, arrows). JoJo's Bizarre Adventure for the energy (colour that changes, poses, ゴゴゴ, To Be Continued).

body.heading: The storyboards
body.text: Three rounds. Version one was too clean. Version two added torn paper and full-screen transitions. Version three added real work, a moving background and a rip that tears in two stages.

body.heading: The palette
body.text: Navy and oxford blue stay fixed. There was a button that rotated four accent palettes, the way Araki recolours a character between panels. It was a gimmick. It's gone, and one palette stayed.

body.heading: The build
body.text: Next.js, hosted free on Vercel. Every tear on this page is generated from a seed, so it looks hand-made but stays the same every visit.
